title: A failed browser run with passing cases and noisy teardown keeps its failing test and error in the gate and revert records
description: Runs a fixture repository whose browser check prints a Playwright failure summary followed by noisy web-server teardown. Through the real trial, whose checkout is cleaned up after, the failing specs, tests and errors survive in the verdict, the reason a revert records, and the batch gate's diagnostic filing - teardown warnings cannot crowd them out - and a run that names no failing test keeps an explicit no-cause marker instead of a quiet diagnosis. The reproduced lifecycle cause is repaired with it: an install whose lifecycle scripts npm's allowlist skipped leaves the embedded Postgres binaries without their library symlinks, so resolving them hydrates what is missing.

steps.name: the failing browser tests and their errors survive cleanup in the trial, revert and gate diagnostic records, and the Postgres binaries hydrate their skipped symlinks
